## Extract Climate Data
```{r,results='hide'}

# Download WorldClim Data
climate_data <- worldclim_country(country = "PAK", var = "bio", res = 2.5,
                                  path = "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling/Data")
bio1 <- climate_data[[1]]   # Temperature
bio12 <- climate_data[[12]] # Precipitation

# Extract Mean Values 
merged_sf$mean_temp <- exact_extract(bio1, merged_sf, 'mean')
merged_sf$mean_precip <- exact_extract(bio12, merged_sf, 'mean')

# Elevation Extraction (get_elev_raster returns WGS84, so use original merged_sf)
elevation_raster <- get_elev_raster(locations = merged_sf, z = 7, clip = "locations")
merged_sf$mean_elev <- exact_extract(elevation_raster, merged_sf, 'mean')

```


## Load Tick Data and Shapefile
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE} 

# Read your CSV which has district names column
tick_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/Bayesian Spatial Modeling/Data/Refine Single file/data_project.csv")

# Read shapefile which is Pakistan shape file with district boundaries
library(sf)

districts_sf <- st_read("C:/Users/abrar/Downloads/Scoping Review Map/Shape File/Pakistn District Level/pak_admbnda_adm2_wfp_20220909.shp")


# Check column names to match
names(districts_sf)  # Look for ADM2_EN

# Standardize names for merging
tick_data$Districts <- tolower(trimws(tick_data$Districts))
districts_sf$ADM2_EN <- tolower(trimws(districts_sf$ADM2_EN))

# Merge tick data with shapefile
merged_sf <- left_join(districts_sf, tick_data, by = c("ADM2_EN" = "Districts"))

#Convert zeros to NA (we only interested in non zero)
merged_sf$R_tick[merged_sf$R_tick == 0] <- NA
merged_sf$H_tick[merged_sf$H_tick == 0] <- NA

```


##  Extraction
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(raster)
library(nasapower)
library(gstat)
library(sf)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(exactextractr)

# Create 1°x1° grid over Pakistan
lons <- seq(65, 76, by = 1)
lats <- seq(24, 37, by = 1)
grid_points <- expand.grid(lon = lons, lat = lats)

#Define function to fetch RH2M from NASA POWER
get_rh <- function(lon, lat) {
  tryCatch({
    data <- get_power(
      community = "AG",
      pars = "RH2M",
      temporal_api = "climatology",
      lonlat = c(lon, lat),
      dates = c("1993", "2023")
    )
    df <- as.data.frame(data)
    data.frame(lon = df$LON, lat = df$LAT, rh = df$ANN)
  }, error = function(e) {
    data.frame(lon = lon, lat = lat, rh = NA)
  })
}

# Download RH2M data
rh_list <- purrr::map2(grid_points$lon, grid_points$lat, get_rh)
pak_rh_all <- bind_rows(rh_list) %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(rh))

# Convert to spatial data
pak_rh_sf <- st_as_sf(pak_rh_all, coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = 4326)
pak_rh_sp <- as(pak_rh_sf, "Spatial")

# Make sure `merged_sf` is in WGS84
merged_sf <- st_transform(merged_sf, crs = 4326)

# Create grid for interpolation using bounding box of districts
bbox <- st_bbox(merged_sf)
grid <- raster::raster(
  xmn = bbox["xmin"], xmx = bbox["xmax"],
  ymn = bbox["ymin"], ymx = bbox["ymax"],
  res = 0.5,
  crs = "+proj=longlat +datum=WGS84"
)
grid_pts <- rasterToPoints(grid, spatial = TRUE)

# Interpolate RH using IDW
idw_rh <- idw(rh ~ 1, pak_rh_sp, newdata = grid_pts)
idw_df <- as.data.frame(idw_rh)[, c("x", "y", "var1.pred")]
idw_raster <- rasterFromXYZ(idw_df)
crs(idw_raster) <- crs(merged_sf)
names(idw_raster) <- "RH"

# Extract interpolated RH values for each district
merged_sf$mean_rh <- exactextractr::exact_extract(idw_raster, merged_sf, 'mean')

# Export district-wise RH to CSV
rh_output <- merged_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(District = ADM2_EN, Relative_Humidity = mean_rh)

setwd("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents")

write.csv(rh_output, "district_relative_humidity of pakistan.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```
